attempted_claim: For H=h=N^{5/6} and major-arc cutoff Q0=(log N)^B with fixed explicit B, the boxed major-arc integral satisfies I_M(n)=S_3(n;Q0)J(n;h)+O(H^2*N^{-1}*(log N)^C*N^{-1/120}) uniformly for odd n in (N,N+H] for all large N; equivalently the truncated-series covering inequality holds with the same power-saving margin over the whole short window.
claim_type: truncated major-arc asymptotic with explicit power-saving error
decisive_failure: The boxed truncated major-arc asymptotic with fixed power saving N^{-1/120} cannot be established unconditionally in this session: every available prime-distribution input (Siegel-Walfisz, Vinogradov-Korobov, Huxley-regime, Bombieri-Vinogradov) is asymptotically weaker than any fixed N-power, with explicit crossovers computed in the artifact.
